visual_style: friendly and emotionally clear for a six-year-old child

composition.text_safe_zone_rule: keep the lower 25 percent visually calm with low detail and no important faces, hands, animals, props, or narrative action
composition.camera: single clear focal point, medium-wide or wide composition unless the scene requires a close emotional moment

within_poem: keep clothing, age, hairstyle, palette, architecture, season and time-of-day logic consistent
treat all scenes of the same poem as pages from the same picture book
across_age_group: avoid modern objects unless explicitly required by the poem interpretation

content_rules: visualize the meaning of the whole physical poem line, not each punctuation-separated phrase
use the child explanation as semantic guidance but do not illustrate extra facts not supported by the poem or explanation
prefer concrete visual storytelling over abstract symbolism for age 6
preserve a gentle emotional tone even for sadness, loneliness, or separation
do not add written Chinese, bopomofo, letters, captions, logos, watermarks, UI, frames, borders, or speech bubbles
